thesis: The episode introduces Mario Therrien, a senior executive at the Canadian pension fund CDP who oversees external manager allocations for approximately $20 billion of the organization's $270 billion total assets. Therrien describes his career progression from building an internal tactical asset allocation group in the early 1990s to creating an internal global macro hedge fund and later establishing a fund-of-funds platform to evaluate external managers.
